newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: Powst. Nielkopolsk loading 26,000 tonnes soymeal.
Dinoussian Seaman loading 53,000 tonnes soybeans. Solidarnosc loading 57,750 tonnes soybeans/meal. Waiting to dock, five vessels to load soymeal and two to load soybeans.
Road: 536 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on July 3, as well as 399 trucks with soymeal and 142 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
Vessels: At public terminal, Huta Sendzimira loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. No vessels waiting to dock. At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked or waiting to dock.
Road: 34 trucks carrying soymeal arrived on July 3.
